notable_absence.finding: No support-plan gate anywhere on this page - bucket-backup UI access is gated purely by capella-role:* (Project Owner, with Organization Owner implying it). The only plan-tier gate found is the free-tier UI-availability restriction above, which is a billing/plan-tier feature gate, not a support-plan gate - directly relevant to this batch's central hypothesis: backup/restore access control uses the SAME capella-role:* mechanism as other management-plane operations, with billing-plan (not support-plan) affecting only feature availability on free tier, not authorization for paid tiers.

cross_component_finding: This file gives the batch's cleanest confirmation of the hypothesis: bucket-backup access control is Project-Owner-gated exactly like other Capella management-plane surfaces (matching cloud/organizations/*.json and cloud/security/cmek.json's identical Organization-Owner/Project-Owner pattern), with no separate backup-specific support-plan requirement. The one genuine plan-tier wrinkle is that free tier clusters lose the UI path entirely and must fall back to the cbbackupmgr CLI - a feature-availability gate, not an authorization gate, and it applies regardless of the user's capella-role:*.
